name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2025-07-08, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
